test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What would be the word on the opposite side of 'Pear' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80dc9b0972c1d15cdaaaeec7401abf1ee1bbd1881e257f70482cadfae231ea77.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e109c35973285670afc4bbd38ee29d5a4d5279caf3677efc914f733a0595212.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

Pear → Lime

Mango → Plum

Kiwi → Melon

Therefore, 'Lime' is the opposite of 'Pear'.

Hence, "Lime" is the correct answer.
